definitions.explanation: A {鍋|なべ} dish in which chicken and vegetables are simmered in water (no seasoning broth) and eaten with ponzu sauce. Particularly associated with Hakata (Fukuoka) and Kansai cuisine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水炊|みずた}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: Hakata-style mizutaki has a rich chicken flavor.

examples.japanese: {水炊|みずた}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ポン{酢|ず}→ポン酢：11115_ponzu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{薬味|やくみ}→薬味：04964_yakumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦さっぱり→さっぱり：02777_sappari⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧だ。
examples.english: It's standard to eat mizutaki refreshingly with ponzu and condiments.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (water) + ⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧ (to simmer/cook). The defining feature is that the broth starts as plain water — flavor comes from the chicken itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {博多|はかた}{水炊|みずた}き: Hakata-style mizutaki
- {鶏|とり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水炊|みずた}き: chicken mizutaki
- {水炊|みずた}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧: mizutaki broth
- ⟦ポン{酢|ず}→ポン酢：11115_ponzu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat with ponzu

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ}→寄せ鍋：22816_yosenabe⟧: mixed hot pot — uses a seasoned broth and many ingredients
- ⟦ちゃんこ{鍋|なべ}→ちゃんこ鍋：24241_chankonabe⟧: chanko nabe — sumo-wrestler style hot pot
